subject: Request to shift demo — added governance & procurement reviewers
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Wright <sam.wright@governancelabs.com>, Marie Owen <marie.owen@governancelabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: Redwood demo next week (30m)

Hi Sam and Marie —

Thanks again for the interest from Governance Labs. We’ve tentatively scheduled a 30-minute demo for next Wednesday at 11:00am PT to walk through the dedicated deployment options and governance controls. High level agenda:
- 10m: quick intros & goals
- 15m: demo (Private deployment, audit logs, KMS integrations)
- 5m: next steps / MAP

Can you confirm that time works? If you want me to include anyone from Security or Procurement, happy to loop them in — just let me know names and roles. I’ll drop the calendar invite once we lock it.

Attached: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.pdf (draft) — this has the checklist we typically walk through.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Sam Wright <sam.wright@governancelabs.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marie Owen <marie.owen@governancelabs.com>, security@governancelabs.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Redwood demo next week (30m)

Hi Priya —

Thanks — quick update on our side: we’ve just onboarded two additional reviewers who must attend any platform evaluations for governance sign-off: our Head of Security (copied to security@governancelabs.com) and the Platform Compliance lead (Marie will introduce). Given their calendars, the 11:00am slot won’t work anymore. Apologies for the churn.

Can we move the session to one of the windows below:
- Thu Aug 5, 9:30–10:00 PT
- Thu Aug 5, 3:00–3:30 PT
- Fri Aug 6, 8:00–8:45 PT (we can make this 45m if helpful)

If none of those work, we can share availability for next week. Also, procurement wants to see high-level pricing and commitment options; if possible, can you bring someone from pricing or senior AE to answer those?

—Sam
Sam Wright
Sr. PM, Governance Labs
sam.wright@governancelabs.com
[External: please note my org’s meeting availability may change due to travel]

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the heads-up and no worries about the change. Karthik (solutions lead) and Rishi (pricing lead) are copied — Rishi can cover procurement questions and Karthik will expand the demo to include the governance controls that Security has asked for.

From our side, we can do Thu Aug 5 at 3:00–3:30 PT (that works best for Karthik and Rishi). If you prefer the 45-minute Fri window, we can do Fri Aug 6 at 8:00–8:45 PT instead — would give us more time for Q&A. Which do you prefer?

If Thu 3pm is good, I’ll send a fresh calendar invite (with the MAP attached) and include the Security and Procurement attendees.

Priya

- Sam Wright (Sr. PM)
- Marie Owen (Platform Compliance)
- Aimee Clark (Head of Security) via security@governancelabs.com
- Jordan Patel (Procurement) via procurement@governancelabs.com — Jordan may step in for procurement questions
